description: Read-side agentSkills injection (Step 3b + Step 5 of /run-reviewers). Changeset is a production class + its test, so arch-reviewer, refactor-advisor, and test-reviewer all fire. The seeded `.claude/pipeline.json` injects `android-testing` into test-reviewer only. The dry-run SKILLS block must show test-reviewer receiving android-testing, and the other two fired reviewers receiving nothing — proving the read side reads `agentSkills`, routes it to the right reviewer, and does NOT leak it into reviewers with no entry. This is the reviewer-side counterpart to run-pipeline/agentskills-injection; before this the reviewer path was dead code (run-reviewers never read agentSkills).
